messages:
tess_cs: Heads-up: CedarBridge hit back-to-back budget alerts overnight. QBR is Fri — they want a 1-pager on cost drivers and 2 remediation paths.
omar_sre: Looking at envoy logs -> embeddings pipeline and analytics job are the top consumers. Quick stat: /v1/embeds accounted for ~72% of tokens in 24h window.
li_eng: Ran a short profile. Two things stand out: repeated ingestion of full docs (no chunking) and many small requests that prevent efficient batching. Snippet:```route=/v1/embeds model=embed-medium total_tokens=1,240,892 requests=2,900 median_req_tokens=427```
noah_solutions: I'll draft an enablement micro-runbook: chunking + client-side batching + embed truncation examples. Prefer a 15-20min live with their infra lead before QBR.
mia_revops: For the renewal ask: propose a 3-month cushion (monthly commit) or a 9-month commit with a step-down discount if they adopt enablement milestones. Need conservative/likely/optimistic savings numbers to present.
budget-bot: [automated] budget-alert cedarbridge.triggered 2026-05-04T01:22:10Z limit=900000 observed=1,150,332
li_eng: Preliminary sim: enabling chunking + batching + prefix cache reduces tokens ~35% in test harness. If we add light int8 quant on Dedicated, extra ~12% compute cost reduction (not tokens).
tess_cs: Good. Action items: (1) li -> per-route delta table (cache on/off, chunking on/off) by EOD tomorrow; (2) noah -> enablement slides + checklist by Wed; (3) mia -> three-scenario commit language and pricing lines by Thu; (4) omar -> confirm canary permissions and run a 48h sim.
omar_sre: Permission confirmed under current NDA; will use redacted payloads. Starting canary tonight, will share summary link.
noah_solutions: I'll include sample code:```# client-side batching pseudo
batcher = Batcher(max_tokens=2048, max_items=16)
for doc in docs:
  for chunk in chunker(doc, 512):
    batcher.add(chunk)
  batcher.flush_when_full()``` plus embed truncation example.
mia_revops: For slides, I'll build two commit asks: (A) 3mo cushion at list price with enablement milestones; (B) 9mo commit with 15% discount contingent on achieving >=25% token reduction within 30 days.
tess_cs: Timeline OK. If the canary confirms >=30% token drop we push for (B) in QBR; otherwise ask for (A) plus 30-day follow-up. Keep AM in the loop.
li_eng: Will post canary numbers and per-route CSV to secure drive once complete.
noah_solutions: Scheduling a 20-min prereq call with their infra lead Thurs morning. I'll invite AM + eng.
tess_cs: Thanks. If anyone spots PHI/PII in samples flag it immediately. Otherwise we'll assemble the one-pager and the QBR deck draft by Thu EOD. :white_check_mark:
